thread:
Nina: Quick heads-up — kicking off the semi-annual entitlement cleanup this Thursday. Goal: validate all admin/RBAC bindings, close ownerless KMS bindings, and surface any audit-log gaps. Meeting Thurs 10am PT for handoff.

Raj: Thanks — can you drop the rough scope? I want to know which keyrings and service accounts are in scope so I can prioritize.

Nina: Scope = prod & staging orgs, keyrings under `redwood-*`, any roles with `roles/*Admin*` or `roles/Owner` bindings, and service accounts with wide iam bindings. Focus first on keys older than 30 days without an explicit owner tag.

Elena: I'll start by enumerating KMS bindings. Posting the command I use so others can reproduce:
```bash
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.[] | {name: .name, iam: .iamConfig}'
```
Will then map iam principals to our identity directory.

Sam: Quick FYI — I noticed an audit-log ingestion dip on 2025-11-02 03:00-03:40 UTC for the `kms.iam.*` events. Not sure if it's retention or a consumer hiccup.

deploy-bot: rotation-job-007 finished: status=ok, completed_at=2025-11-02T03:14:21Z (trigger: cron).

Maya: If rotation-job-007 touched roles or temporarily elevated a service account, that could explain the missing window (rotation jobs sometimes emit events under a different principal). I'll correlate rotation logs vs ingestion timestamps.

Raj: For ownerless bindings I'm going to create an owners spreadsheet and tag entries with `owner: unknown` if we can't map within 48h: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/owners-scrub (will share perms).

Elena: Also sharing a quick BigQuery query to find admin role grants older than 90 days — adapt as needed:
```sql
SELECT principal, role, resource, granted_at
FROM `redwood-org.iam.audit_bindings`
WHERE role LIKE '%Admin%' OR role LIKE '%Owner%'
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), granted_at, DAY) > 90;
```

Sam: I'll add a Splunk/SIEM widget for `admin bind changes` and surface anomalies to this channel. That should help catch rebindings after we start the freeze.

Nina: Decision items: 1) freeze ownerless KMS bindings older than 30d (no destructive changes until owners are assigned), 2) create tickets for each frozen binding with remediation owner = `sec-eng` default if unclaimed after 7 days, 3) escalate any audit-ingest gaps >30m to infra oncall.

Maya: Sounds good. I'll triage the ingestion gap first and report back by EOD.

Raj: I'll take ownership of identifying ownerless keys for app infra and share the sheet by EOD tomorrow.

Elena: Will run the IAM enumeration tonight and drop a CSV into the shared folder.

Nina: Thanks all. Please review the runbook before the meeting: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/access-entitlement-cleanup. Bring any blockers to the 10am PT sync. I'll close this thread after the meeting with action items. :thumbsup:
